snippet.title: Planet Zoo: Zookeepers Animal Pack | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Planet Zoo: Zookeepers Animal Pack is available now on PC! Seven new species, 95+ stunning scenery pieces AND a very special new campaign scenario. Buy Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146420/Planet_Zoo_Zookeepers_Animal_Pack

This collection includes the solitary and astute Pallas cat; the Hamadryas baboon, a symbol of ancient wisdom and social complexity; and the unique-looking, playful Spectacled bear.    

Alongside these iconic new additions, the Zookeepers Animal Pack also features 95+ stunning scenery pieces alongside a brand-new campaign scenario, where you will join the team in celebrating five years of Planet Zoo at the famous Frontier Zoo, ensuring the party is a storming success! 

For more news and information about Planet Zoo 👇
